about.headline: Rodrigo Maya — IT Support Engineer & Data Analyst (Oracle, PL/SQL) — now building full stack apps and preparing for AWS Data Engineer.
about.intro: Over a decade supporting mission-critical, 24/7 enterprise systems on Oracle PL/SQL and Microsoft SQL Server — for global brands and multi-industry consulting clients. I am finishing the final project of a full stack program (TypeScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB) and preparing for the AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate exam.
about.status: Open to remote roles · support, SQL/data, full stack

experience.desc: Level 2 support of Nespresso's Supply Chain systems in a global 24/7 follow-the-sun operation (India, Romania, Mexico). Analyzed incidents through PL/SQL code and daily SQL queries, traced rejected purchase orders across Nesoft, Nesoa and SAP payloads — cutting resolution from typically 2–3 days to a few hours — and escalated documented findings to L3.

experience.client: Condor Consulting — Aeroméxico · Grupo Vidanta · Alsea
experience.desc: Developed Oracle PL/SQL and SQL Server T-SQL stored procedures, data-load interfaces and customizations for ERP and BI projects. Contributed to a SAP–Oracle integration for Aeroméxico (control tables, import/load/export processes), delivered OBIEE/BI Publisher reports for Grupo Vidanta, and remediated programs for Alsea's Oracle-led EBS R11→R12 migration.
